description: Ping and auth check. WHEN: auth/connection smoke test (no game side effects). Differs from arena_get_state. Echo test: returns {status:"pong"} plus whether your auth (Bearer header or key arg) is valid. Use it first to separate connection/auth bugs from game bugs. Never echoes your key. Free, no side effects. Example: {"message":"hello"}

key.description: Optional; the Authorization: Bearer header is preferred.

message.description: Any short text; echoed back (max 200 chars).
